data.name: Collect.ToolTip
data.value: Reads the cable trays, conduits and circuits of this model and its links, and reports what was found.

data.name: Route.ToolTip
data.value: Routes every circuit through the trays and conduits of this model, and compares the computed length with the one Revit reports.

data.name: Parameters.ToolTip
data.value: Writes the shared parameter file for family authors and binds the parameters this model is missing.

data.name: CheckLengths.ToolTip
data.value: Routes every circuit again and says which ones carry a stored length that no longer describes this model.

data.name: Inspector.ToolTip
data.value: Shows and hides the pane with what the cable calculation wrote on the selected element: a circuit's length and route, the circuits through a tray, conduit or box, an indicator's recommendation.

data.name: Carriers.ToolTip
data.value: Says which of this model's categories carry cable, and which of their elements count. The rules belong to the model, so everyone who opens it gets the same answer.
